posts.name: liarliar
posts.cooked:
I really enjoyed this one! I like Naturalist as a character, but he sometimes feels quite disconnected from the rest of the Sentinels ‘verse, so having these characters around him really helps flesh out his life and his story.

I really love all the Secret Identity drama, with people knowing or eventually learning the secret...good stuff, and something we don’t get much of in Sentinels.

posts.name: MindWanderer
posts.cooked: Regarding the argument about who's the best at running a business: Both Chairman Pike and Maia Montgomery do a great job, but consider that Maia is only doing hers part-time!  She's managing a huge corporation, plus patrolling the streets at night, plus galavanting off with the Freedom Five, and her company is still successful.

posts.cooked:
Apparently Freya at age 4 was a supervillain. You’ve heard of Captain Atom’s enemy turned ally on the Justice League, Major Disaster…Freya Rebottaro is Miner Disaster.

It’d be fun if Crocodile (not Alligator, you embarrassing armchair herpetologists!) Naturalist ate an entire drowned hippo leg, then took human form, and the magic that transmutes his body also turns the contents of his stomach into cheeseburgers and potato salad. I agree that it’s more useful for storytelling purposes if he needs to digest most of his meal before he can change. It can’t really affect the intestine contents much, since that’s never really empty in any healthy animal, but you can definitely say he needs an “empty” (mostly) stomach. He must be at least slightly hungry to change.

I really want an Akash’Bhuta promo that’s the Inverse Powersiverse version, where she’s made of water on one side, air on the other, and doesn’t use her Limbs at all.

First episode of March 2020. What an ironic time for them to sign off with a crack about creating the future you want to see…
